newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Timah Q1 net down to 26.5 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Timah Q1 net down to 26.5 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian tin miner PT Tambang Timah said it posted a net profit of 26.5 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 39.4 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
Timah, the world's largest integrated tin mining firm which is also listed in London, said in a statement received on Wednesday the fall was mainly due to weak tin prices on the world market.
It said the average tin price received by the firm had fallen to $5,960 per tonne in the first quarter of 1997 from $6,299 per tonne in the first quarter of 1996.
The statement said net income per share for the first quarter of 1997 fell to 53 rupiah from 78 rupiah in the same period last year. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
